name: Probability of default
definition: Model probability of the recorded charge-off target.

name: Debt-to-income ratio
definition: Existing debt payments relative to income; source debt definition needs confirmation.

name: Receiver operating characteristic area under the curve
definition: Probability a positive ranks above a negative, with half credit for ties.

name: Precision–recall area under the curve
definition: Here reported as average precision, not trapezoidal PR area.

name: Expected calibration error
definition: Weighted absolute predicted/observed gap across probability bins.

name: Cross-validation
definition: Repeated training/validation folds used inside training for selection.

name: Fair Isaac Corporation score
definition: Reported credit-score range is consolidated to its midpoint.

name: Loan-to-income ratio
definition: Requested principal divided by annual income.

name: Probability agreement
definition: Predicted probabilities agree with event frequencies in relevant groups.

name: Incomplete outcome observation
definition: Final outcomes are unknown for some loans at the dataset snapshot.

name: Risk ranking
definition: How well a model orders positive outcomes above negative outcomes.

name: Logistic score calibration
definition: A validation-fitted logistic transform of raw score log-odds.

name: Resampling for uncertainty
definition: Sample loan indices with replacement; paired comparisons reuse the same indices.

name: Scheduled interest before costs
definition: Total repayment minus principal under the no-default repayment schedule. Not net profit.
